use_case: AI intake assistant for trip requests: transcribes recorded request calls, pre-fills the trip request, suggests a level of service and PCS checklist, and flags possible emergencies for redirection to 911
vendor_or_model: Operations platform vendor feature (speech-to-text plus a language model, cloud subprocessor)
data_categories: Call audio; transcripts; patient name, addresses, condition, insurance details; suggested level of service; emergency flag (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Scheduler-Dispatcher asks the Medical Director's 911 redirect questions on every call and decides; the flag can only add a 911 reminder, never clear one; level-of-service suggestions switched off from 2026-09-08; pre-filled fields checked against the caller
applicable_laws: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (BAA coverage of the AI subprocessor required); 45 CFR 92.210 (patient care decision support tool; the company receives Medicaid funds); Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) (all-party consent to recording; counsel to confirm the announcement); Fla. Stat. 501.171
status: Pilot in restricted advisory use (1 user); continues only if the BAA confirmation arrives by 2026-10-15; re-assessment 2026-12-15
